Text included: A specialty label that contains orthopaedic or orthopedic, or the abbreviation ortho surg, for example Orthopedic Surgery, Orthopaedic Surgery of the Spine, Orthopedic Sports Medicine and Pediatric Orthopaedic Surgery
Text excluded: Labels that name a non-physician, equipment or dental role (physical or occupational therapy, athletic training, chiropractic, massage, podiatry, technologist, technician, appliance, shoe, footwear, brace, prosthesis, orthotic, aide, durable medical equipment, supplier, orthodontics, dentofacial orthopedics, non-surgical); records that also carry a physician assistant, nurse practitioner, advanced practice registered nurse, nurse or surgical-assistant label
Reason: Physician-level orthopaedic text only; records with a non-physician co-label are counted in the next row

Text included: Orthopaedic text as in the row above, with a physician assistant, nurse practitioner, advanced practice registered nurse, nurse or surgical-assistant label in the same record
Text excluded: The same non-physician, equipment and dental labels as in the row above; records without such a co-label (they count as surgeons)
Reason: Counted separately from surgeons and used only in the APC-inclusive sensitivity analysis

Text included: Labels that contain dermatology, derm as a whole word or Mohs, including dermatopathology, Mohs surgery, and pediatric and procedural dermatology
Text excluded: Records that also carry a physician assistant, nurse practitioner, advanced practice registered nurse, nurse or surgical-assistant label; esthetic and cosmetology labels
Reason: Negative-control specialty (taxonomy family 207N); physician level, mirroring the orthopaedic surgeon rule

Text included: Labels that contain ophthalmology (including the misspelling ophthamology and the abbreviation ophth), oculoplastic or retina specialist
Text excluded: Records that also carry a physician assistant, nurse practitioner, advanced practice registered nurse, nurse or surgical-assistant label; ophthalmic technician, technologist, assistant, photographer and medical labels; optician, optometry and orthoptist labels
Reason: Negative-control specialty (taxonomy family 207W); optometry is not ophthalmology and ophthalmic technicians and assistants are not physicians

Text included: Labels that contain orthotic, prosthetic or orthoptist
Reason: Orthotists, prosthetists and orthoptists are not orthopaedic surgeons

Text included: A label that is exactly Sports Medicine
Reason: Sports Medicine alone is open to non-surgeons (family and emergency medicine, physiatry) and is not counted without orthopaedic text

Text included: A label that is exactly Physician Assistant (or PA, PA-C)

Reason: Podiatry is a separate taxonomy family, not the orthopaedic family 207X

Text included: Labels that contain physical therapy, occupational therapy or athletic training
Reason: Therapists and trainers are not surgeons, including orthopaedic-certified therapists

Text included: A label that is exactly Hand Surgery (or Surgery, Hand)
Reason: Hand surgery alone is shared by plastic, orthopaedic and general surgeons; it is counted only when orthopaedic text is also present
